Library Services

Library

Room: 301, Floor: 2, Building: 3, BUBT Main Campus

About the Office

BUBT Central Library is located at 2nd & 3rd floors, Martyred Tahmid Abdullah Building, operates daily from 9:00 am to 09:00 pm, covering a total area of 14,488 sq. ft. with a reading room capacity of 280, it houses an extensive collection of resources, including 32000+ printed books, 3000+ printed journals, 350+ Audio-visual materials, and 8,068+ titles of e-journals and 12,250 titles of e-books (JSTOR , Manupatra and Research4Life) and other scholarly materials. The library's management system is powered by Koha-ILS library management Software and DSpace software. Various dedicated sections within the library include the Independence and Liberation War Corner, an online catalogue search zone, a circulation section, book processing section, a stock area for theses and internship reports, six reading rooms, a safekeeping area, three  mobile and laptop charging stations, and the office of library officials.

Moreover, the library boasts its own website, digital repository (DSpace), and Online Public Access Catalogue, which are providing patrons with 24/7 access to resources from anywhere via the internet. The library offers a range of services, including lending services (book issue, return & renew), reference service, reading room service, journal and daily newspaper service, internet facilities, current awareness service (CAS), library Wi-Fi, printing facility, group discussion zone, library clearance services, reader guidance service, and reprographic service. Additionally, library users are welcome to use their own laptops within the library premises. Recently, the BUBT Library has been providing Turnitin software services to detect plagiarism and AI-generated content.

Services of Our Office

Reference & Research Support

• Assistance in finding information and using resources. • Research consultations, citation management, and plagiarism checks.

Information Literacy & Training

• Orientation for new students. • Workshops on database searching, copyright, and ethical use of information. • Training on research tools (Mendeley, EndNote, Turnitin, etc.).

Digital & IT Services

• Online Public Access Catalogue (OPAC) and library management systems. • Access to remote e-resources and digital repositories. • Wi-Fi, computer labs, printing, scanning, and reprography.

Study and Learning Spaces

• Reading rooms, quiet study zones, and group discussion areas. • Internet browsing sections and multimedia facilities. • Extended hours during exams.

Current Awareness & Information Services

• Current Awareness Service (CAS) – updates about new arrivals. • Selective Dissemination of Information (SDI) – customized alerts for users. • News clipping, bulletin boards, and newsletters.

Specialized Support

• Support for faculty in course material preparation. • Thesis/dissertation submission and archiving.
